risk.rationale: The only verified evidence is F1 (LIKELY 0.6): a sign-in from an unseen device PH-9900 (usual device LT-6002) for b.cetin@aegean.edu, mapped to T1078. The two password-spray-then-success narratives (from 78.187.4.44 and 193.140.10.17) are rejected: both IPs are shared egress with far more distinct MFA-completing accounts than the spray threshold (186 and 208 respectively vs threshold 10), so the failures are background noise, not a coordinated spray against this account. There is no confirmed account-takeover chain (no confirmed credential compromise, MFA bypass, or post-compromise activity). F1 is a single weak, unexplained signal, insufficient for contain and not fully explained away for benign. Decision: monitor.
